planName: Meal Plan Creation Overhaul - Updated Based on Current State

vision.foodPlan: Trainer manually sets total calories and macro grams per day. No auto-calculation overriding trainer input. Remove per-meal calories/macros display; daily totals only.
vision.clientTracking: No per-meal calorie goal. Daily goal only (trainer sets). User chooses food options and quantity from each category; calories and macros are calculated from those. Swapping/adding/removing food updates totals. Date navigation (prev/today/next) for logging different days. Per-meal row shows calculated total only (sum of items in that meal). Add Food from bank, Complete button per meal. Reference: inspiration screenshot (daily Kcal P C F at top, meal sections with calculated totals, food list + Add Food + Complete).
vision.foodBank: Single filter (no duplicate filter under search and under box). Per-portion vs per-100g option (e.g. slice of bread: 1 slice, 2 slices). Excel import: always preview (no auto-import); Hebrew-first matching; per-row review (Skip / Add / Replace existing) like Explorer replace dialog; same flow for Exercise Bank.

excelFoodPlanStructure.idea: One sheet per day or one sheet with day column; columns: day/meal_name, slot, food_name_he/en, quantity, unit (g or portion). Optional: macros per row. Backend already has meal plan Excel import; verify structure in app/routers/meal_system.py.
